alex: Heads-up — after the fallback-routing rollout last night we're seeing small invoice deltas for ~0.3% of tenants. tokens look inflated vs edge proxies. cc @maya :eyes:
maya: saw that in the hourly dashboard too. spike aligns with fallback policy flip at 22:58 UTC. looks like requests that hit primary then fallback are being double-counted in the metering stream
kevin: do we have a good unique key in the ingest events? I thought request_id dedupe was on, but routing makes new event per attempt
jordan: reproducing: primary returns 503, client retries -> proxy routes to fallback model, both attempts create meter events. our ingest doesn't fold attempts because req_id is different after the proxy rewrite
alex: exactly — proxy rewrites request_id for routing reasons. so ledger sees two distinct req ids and attributes both :/
leo: quick suggestion: add an "attempt_id" or carry original_req_id across rewrites. alternative: produce an idempotency_key at the proxy that combines client_req_id + original_route_id + session_ts and attach to events
maya: attaching original_req_id would be ideal but not trivial for older proxies. idempotency_key seems safer short-term
kevin: agree. proposal: at edge make idempotency_key = sha256(client_id + ":" + original_req_id + ":" + route_attempt_bucket) and include it on metering events. aggregator won't emit duplicates if same key seen within X minutes
jordan: caution: we use compacting windows in tally service. need to ensure key TTL matches rollup window, otherwise legitimate retries could be deduped incorrectly
alex: good point. timeline: dedupe-window should be same as compact window (currently 2m). ops-bot: created ticket MET-914 to track
ops-bot: Ticket MET-914 created by alex: "ingest: add idempotency_key generation at edge proxy to dedupe fallback attempts". priority P2, owner: TBD
leo: sample code idea to attach (pseudo):
```
# edge proxy pseudo
orig = headers.get('x-original-req') or headers.get('x-client-req')
bucket = int(now / 120)
idempotency_key = sha256(f"{tenant_id}:{orig}:{bucket}")
event['idempotency_key'] = idempotency_key
emit_to_metering(event)
```
kevin: looks good. also need adapter in aggregator so it checks idempotency_key and ignores events with same key within N seconds. fallback: emit a tombstone flag when deduped so console can explain omitted events
maya: console UX: add a small annotation on tenant invoice preview saying "X events deduped due to routing retries" with link to MET-914. helps support + customers
alex: agree. also flag in per-route dashboard: show pre-dedupe vs post-dedupe token counts for transparency
jordan: question: will this change affect sampling/preview snapshots? our preview uses sampled events before aggregator, so dedupe might not apply and previews could still show inflated numbers
leo: we can apply same idempotency step in preview pipeline or move preview sampling after dedupe. tradeoff: preview latency vs accuracy
kevin: operational checklist: 1) edge proxy patch to emit idempotency_key (canary) 2) aggregator change to ignore duplicates 3) preview pipeline adjust 4) console annotations + metric cards pre/post dedupe 5) backfill detection job to find affected invoices
maya: canary window: 2 hours on a small tenant cohort (10 tenants) starting tomorrow 03:00 UTC. I'll own canary list
alex: i'll do aggregator patch. kevin, can you own preview pipeline change? jordan/leo help with proxy canary rollout
kevin: yep I'll take preview. will add test harness to simulate 503->fallback attempts
jordan: I'll handle proxy rollout with leo. plan to use feature flag so we can toggle idempotency header generation
ops-bot: MET-914 updated: owner assignments: maya (canary cohort), alex (aggregator PR), kevin (preview pipeline), jordan/leo (proxy canary). ETA: canary tomorrow 03:00 UTC, full rollout pending canary results
alex: thanks all. follow-up in MET-914 with links to PRs and the dashboard card mocks. goal: eliminate the duplicate-invoice delta and add transparency to console in one sprint
leo: also leaving a note: watch for edge latency increase from added hashing — should be negligible but measure
maya: will add dashboard query panels: tokens_raw, tokens_deduped, dedupe_rate. throw alerts if dedupe_rate > 1% over 1h after rollout
kevin: cool. i'll wire preview to show both numbers and an explanation. PRs incoming today
alex: great. finishing note: we should also add a small doc in eng docs about routing-induced metering pitfalls for oncall. saves time next incident
ops-bot: reminder scheduled: MET-914 canary kickoff 03:00 UTC tomorrow
